contract.encoded_profile: path-free MP4, H.264, YUV420P, eight-bit, no audio, no alpha, and no container metadata
contract.source_binding: the encoded semantic identity binds the exact source component VIDEO semantic digest, encoded content digest, dimensions, reduced frame rate, and frame count
contract.service_result: NativeComponentH264Mp4BackingService returns the canonical Encoded VIDEO representation
contract.stored_handle_kind: one existing VIDEO variant in NativeStoredPayload

test_cases: the existing component constructor preserves the component semantic digest and alias-aware residency contract
the narrow encoded constructor accepts only one valid eight-bit CPU F32 component source and one checked CPU U8 encoded Tensor
the encoded representation recomputes the content digest and derives the source digest rather than accepting caller-forged source identity
the actor output Tensor StorageId is unchanged in the canonical encoded payload
component and encoded representations have distinct semantic domains while retaining one VIDEO handle kind
component-only planners, nodes, provider transport, and plugin projection reject encoded backing without decoding it
projection failure and cancellation drop the candidate encoded payload without publication and allow a clean retry
